programme.title: Stories of the Mediterranean Forest: Sierra Morena
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Basin is one of the planet’s most biologically rich and complex regions. The crossroads of Europe, Asia and Africa is considered to be one of Earth’s biodiversity hotspots. A vast number of both animal and plant species unique to the region live in its various habitats. The Mediterranean Basin is located in one of the planet’s temperate zones. The subtropical climate makes it colder and wet here in winter, hot and dry in summer and mild and rainy in autumn and spring.

programme.title: Fertile Floods - Croatia's Wetlands
programme.desc: Every year, in the middle of Croatia, it's the same story: after the annual snowmelt, a huge flood wave spills out of the Alps toward Zagreb and Belgrade. This leads to an increase in the River Sava's water levels of some ten metres. The contents of more than ten billion bathtubs floods an area the size of Lake Constance, often for months on end, yet still the Croatian and Serbian capital is spared a flood disaster. One of the reasons for this is the fact that the Sava is able to flow unhindered. The annual floods not only create a natural retention reservoir for flood control: alongside the Sava lies a natural paradise, unique in Central Europe. In the species-rich, alluvial flood forests of the last major meadow landscapes of the continent, enormous predatory fish like the catfish lie in wait for prey. The fertile floodplains of the Sava are an important resting place for more than 240 bird species, including Hoopoe, great crested Grebe, little Egret, common snipe and pied Avocet. Old, domestic livestock breeds like the Turopolje pig and Posavina horse spend almost the entire year in the floodplains. They appreciate the alluvial meadows, keep puddles and mudholes open whilst wallowing and, as living lawnmowers, they ensure that the moist meadows aren't transformed into dense oak forests. Thanks to this traditional pasture farming, more than 700 pairs of white stork alone breed in the Lonjsko Polje National Park. The Sava Floodplains allow us to glance into the past of our continent and at the same time, illustrate just how flood protection for major towns can be perfected.

programme.title: Europe's Wild River - The Elbe - 1.000 Miles of Wildlife and Nature
programme.desc: The river rises in the Czech Giant Mountains. Here it is called the Labe. After Děčín it flows into Germany and is called Elbe. There are various explanations for the origin of the river name "Elbe". One often mentioned is the Latin name of the river "albia", which means "bright water". This would also explain why the stream is referred to with the feminine article "the Elbe", since the Latin term "albia" is also feminine. Rather poetic than linguistically probable, however, is the explanation that elves (Middle High German: alb) scurrying around the pines in the white river mists could have helped the river to get its name. Geographically, the river can be divided into different sections: The Upper Elbe is the part from the source to about Riesa in the administrative district of Dresden, which is more characterized by mountains. The Middle Elbe, on the other hand, is a lowland river. It reaches as far as the Geesthacht dam just outside Hamburg. The Lower Elbe is called the tidal part of the river. Here, the Elbe forms an estuary, a so-called estuary. At high tide, seawater enters this funnel-shaped delta at the mouth of the Elbe and mixes with the freshwater of the river. At low tide, the water then flows off to the North Sea. Finally, the continuation of the estuary funnel in the Wadden Sea is called the Outer Elbe.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature’s best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: The journey leads from the Norwegian Vesterålen to Chad, the Aeolian Islands and the Polish Giant Mountains. As different as the landscapes and cultures may be, all people are united in their love for their children and their desire to give something to tomorrow's generation.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: What ideas are people on the 15th meridian east developing to shape the future and leave tomorrow's generations a home worth living in? This consequence leads us to four future designers. From the barren Namib Desert to the glacier worlds of Spitsbergen, Sicily and the Croatian Mediterranean.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari’s Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area’s water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: Alpine Lakes - Dark Depths and Icy Heights
programme.desc: This is a nature documentary, which leads us into the fascinating world of deep mountain lakes. We conquer ice palaces of unsuspected beauty. In the freezers, in which elves, fairies and mountain trolls once did their mischief, we move, using a special breathing technique and with special cameras in search of nocturnal hunters, whose eyes are equipped with residual light amplifying receptors.

programme.title: Montenegro - From the Black Mountains to the Beach
programme.desc: The Balkan land of Montenegro owes its name to the Black Mountains. But there is so much more: steep cliffs, deep gorges, picturesque lakes, orthodox monasteries, Venetian architecture, sandy beaches and even fjords like those of Norway. There are three climate zones alone in the Adriatic. The inhabitants still try to find their way between the challenges of a post-socialist system, the much-vaunted Balkan remoteness and the opportunities of a still almost completely undiscovered tourist destination in Europe.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.desc: The moon disappears behind the horizon and the stage is set for a new day in the Alps of Berchtesgaden.

programme.title: Wild Bavaria
programme.sub-title: Wild Bavaria - In The Shadow of the Watzmann.
programme.desc: Mighty and mysterious, King Watzmann sits above Germany's only alpine national park.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, Florida - The Sunshine State
programme.desc: Nowhere is the American way of life as relaxed as on Florida's beaches. The Keys, a chain of islands at the far southern end of the state, reveal a more laid-back side of the USA. But all of Florida amazes -- with secluded beaches, unspoiled nature, and the legacy of the early European settlers.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The City and the Sea
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.sub-title: The U.S. East Coast, The Heart of New England
programme.desc: From New York, the journey up the coast leads into the heart of New England. We visit Yale; spend some time in the 19th century mansions at Newport, RI; tour the coastal fishing and vacation towns of Massachusetts, and then meet a modern entrepreneur in Boston and see her rooftop gardens.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: Wild Baltic - Life on the Amber Coast
programme.desc: The first episode of this two-part nature documentary presents the natural beauty of the shifting sand dunes of the Curonian Spit, the romantic beaches of the Latvian Baltic Sea and the island worlds of Estonia. Time and again, this deserted and almost untouched nature fascinates. In the winter, ringed seals give birth to their young on the pack ice. In the spring, Konik wild horse stallions fight fierce battles amongst themselves, while colourful European rollers fly through the dune forests. Lynxes wander through the coastal forests and in the orchid meadows turncoats and hoopoes find more than enough food. On the islands around Saaremaa in Estonia, grey seals hunt for fish. They share the archipelago with Europe’s largest tern, the Caspian tern.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: Wild Baltic - Enchanted Forests and Moors
programme.desc: The wide, often untouched wilderness of the Baltic hinterland is home to many animals. More than 35 brown bears live in the primeval forests of Alutaguse. In the spring, the Soomaa National Park transforms into a huge lake. Europe's widest waterfall is located in Latvia. In the beginning of May, vimba bream follow the course of the River Venta. The hardly 5-centimetre-long fish have to overcome a 4-metre-long rock barrier in order to reach their spawning grounds.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Halsema Highway, situated on the island Luzon, leads right through the Philippine jungle with its frequent fog and heavy rainfalls. Every trip on this so-called road is an adventure and highly dangerous. We accompany a bus driver and a taxi driver on their challenging trip across the mountains.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Canadian ice roads exist only for a few months in the winter when the ice is thick enough. The only time of the year when goods can be transported up to Northern Manitoba. We accompany the truckers Vlad and Hugh as well as the aboriginal Canadian Scott with his pick-up on their long journey to a village called God’s Lake. A risky trip in icy temperatures, sometimes even below - 60 degrees Celcius. The men are in constant danger of getting stuck and need to forget everything they ever learnt about driving on a highway in order to arrive safely.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: India's state of Rajasthan is known for its ancient palaces, vast landscapes - and wild transport routes. For thousands of years, dromedaries served as the most important means of transport. Today, India's roads are considered fast-paced, chaotic and unpredictable. On a journey through the desert state, we discover its rough roads.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872. Yellowstone was the first national park in the U.S. and is also widely held to be the first national park in the world. The park is known for its wildlife and its many geothermal features, especially Old Faithful geyser, one of its most popular. While it represents many types of biomes, the subalpine forest is the most abundant. It is part of the South Central Rockies forests ecoregion.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: America's National Parks - Great Smoky Mountains
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: North America’s National Parks are world famous and their breathtaking landscapes fascinate millions of visitors. This spectacular series will show you what happens beyond the lookouts. Everglades National Park is an American national park that protects the southern twenty percent of the original Everglades in Florida. The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

The park is the largest tropical wilderness in the United States, and the largest wilderness of any kind east of the Mississippi River. An average of one million people visit the park each year. Everglades is the third-largest national park in the contiguous United States after Death Valley and Yellowstone. UNESCO declared the Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve in 1976, and listed the park as a World Heritage Site in 1979, while the Ramsar Convention included the park on its list of Wetlands of International Importance in 1987. Everglades is one of only three locations in the world to appear on all three lists.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: Darkwoods - Where Nature Survives
programme.desc: Half a century ago the German Duke Carl von Württemberg purchased a 55.000-hectare parcel of land in the Selkirk Mountains in British Columbia, Canada. He baptized his holdings after his native Black Forest, "Darkwoods", and managed the forests in the lonely region sustainably.

programme.title: mareTV: The Caribbean for explorers: St. Vincent and the Grenadines
programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. Every morning, the 32-year-old navigates from yacht to yacht with her small bright green service vehicle and is already expected by most skippers. Miranda promises radiantly fresh laundry, which she delivers again the same day. And so there is always something going on in her tiny laundrette in the harbour. It turns into a karaoke bar in the evening, because that is Miranda's great passion. Eban Olliver has many jobs at once. He is the lighthouse keeper of Kingstown. And that means a lot of responsibility in St. Vincent's biggest port city. Because Eban doesn't just change the light bulbs, he's a pilot dispatcher, harbour master and guard all in one person. First contact with ships is particularly important. Once he even saved the entire nation from an Ebola virus.

programme.title: mareTV: Martinique
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' "problem kids": they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Orphanage of Elephants - Nairobi Nationalpark
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm’s urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.sub-title: Elephants: Back to the Wild: The Return of the Elephants - Tsavo-East-Nationalpark
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Italy My Love
programme.desc: In ten coastal areas of Italy, we encounter people that have a very special relationship with their region. All of them love their country, their traditions and their work. We met with enthusiasts and hedonists that permitted us to take a glimpse into their everyday lives. Young Italians, who have rediscovered nature and its treasures. Others, that preserve the beauty, archaeologists that apply whole new methods, farmers that only cultivate that which the soil needs. Fishermen, who fish in the same way as it was done a century ago and tough, young men who play and dance the Tarantella. Dolphins, giant sea turtles and pink flamingos, which are researched, nursed back to health or simply observed. Cave explorers, sail makers and coffee specialists are also part of the big picture. Flying drone cameras provide birds-eye views and are an important element of the films. The results are spectacular images from completely different angles which provide us with landscape overviews and detailed insights, the likes of which have never been seen before.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In Provence
programme.desc: Its native fragrant flowers and aromatic herbs have made the Provence a brand known worldwide. The wealth of flora found in this region, between the French Alps and the Mediterranean, is unequalled among the French provinces. Around Sault, near Mont Ventoux, the valleys and high plains are carpeted with bright violet: In the hot climate of the South of France, lavender blooms and exudes its fragrance. Monastic healers have been using its aromatic medicinal oil since the Middle Ages. And today an entire industry is based on the trade with this fragrant flower. Yet the livelihood of Provençal lavender farmers is imperiled. In France’s major lavender-growing region, the “Plateau de Valensole”, our viewers encounter Gérard Blanc, who has been hit particularly hard. The lavender farmer lost sixty percent of his harvest to one tiny insect: the leafhopper. This insect has already destroyed half of the lavender acreage, bumping France from its market position as the world’s top producer of lavender oil. The film visits a resolute farmer who, not about to give up, is testing methods to fend off the voracious insect.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In India
programme.desc: In India, herbs play an everyday role hardly equalled anywhere in the world. From the tropical green south to the mountains of the northern Himalayas, herbs lend fragrance to joss sticks and soaps, and flavor to the cuisine. And, above all, herbs heal. Six thousand varieties of plants are used in India, and most are harvested in the wild – where they are becoming depleted. The ever rising need for herbal medicine for the subcontinent’s 1.3 billion inhabitants comes on top of the demand of its growing middle class for herbal-based cosmetics. As a result, certain herbs have become scarce, while others have already vanished entirely. Most of the herbs in India are harvested in the wild. The progress of first cultivation attempts is slow. In India, the rural population, especially, needs affordable, well-tolerated medicine – medicine based on herbs. In Kerala, the film shows a family operation that hand-produces botanical medicine for the local market. High up in the Himalayas, we observe a village healer at work. The science of Ayurvedic medicine is five thousand years old. Today, interest in the ancient healing art is surging, not only in India. In Delhi’s Old Town, the film visits a wholesaler who supplies the booming global herb market, and we take a look inside the laboratories of the largest manufacturer of Ayurvedic medicines in the world. In Kerala, we meet a doctor employed at a small Ayurveda clinic, and in Nordern India, we join a student of Tibetan medicine on a hike up into the mountains, where she prepares for an exam in herbology.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.sub-title: The Secret World of Herbs - In Latin America
programme.desc: Healing effects, fragrance, and intense flavor – the benefits of herbs were discovered by the indigenous peoples of South America long before Spanish conquistadores subdued the continent. Even today, in the remote regions of South America, life without herbs is unthinkable. For many inhabitants, they provide the sole medicine. For more than two thousand years, this wisdom of the healing powers of nature has been passed down from generation to generation. In Bolivia, the film accompanies ethnobiologist Rainer Bussmann on one of his expeditions documenting which herbs the locals use against which illnesses. The German scientist has spent the last 15 years in the region, focussed on preserving this invaluable knowledge.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: As contrasting as the landscapes of the 15th meridian east, so different are its animal inhabitants. What are the living conditions like in the heat of the Namibian Damaraland, in Lusatia or on the coast of Norway? Which challenges do elephants, whales or kingfishers have to master together with their companions from north to south?

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: Almost 11000 kilometres lie between the northernmost and southernmost point of the 15th meridian east. Here you will find extreme landscapes such as the shimmering heat of Africa or the eternal cold of northern Scandinavia. Five people from Spitsbergen, Namibia, Slovenia, Germany and Poland dedicate their lives to environmental protection.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: This episode focuses on people from five countries who share a common passion: The production of their own food and food. What culinary treasures are hidden in the different regions, from Spitsbergen to Sweden, Austria, Poland and Chad?

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.sub-title: The Road To Death In The Andes
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. We accompany trucker Omar and his co-driver Jaime on their trip across the Andes, encountering cyclists, mountain bikers and coca-farmers on the way.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Half Pipe Dreams

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Cold Hard Cash
programme.desc: Ton and Allen go North to Alaska and get a cold reception from the local auctioneer. They find two enormous seaplane pontoons and a pair of Smith & Wesson revolvers, including the most powerful production handgun in the world!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hot Wheels
programme.desc: '70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Driller Instinct
programme.desc: Ton & Allen encounter aggressive outdoorsmen in the Alaskan wilderness. The guys discover an 8-wheeled ATV that travels on both land & water and an air percussion hammer that can drill through solid rock!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Ruff Day
programme.desc: Ton and Allen head to an auction in Ton's hometown and end up battling with a big-mouthed buyer. They discover a pair of tranquilizer dart guns and also end up fighting with a K9!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Choo-Choo, Cha-Ching!
programme.desc: Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer. They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960's and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Early Bird Special
programme.desc: Vintage Shooting Star carnival game; professional Mixed Martial Arts octagon fighting cage.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Shuffle
programme.desc: Ton and Allen teach a cocky new auction hunter a lesson. They spot a 1940's-era shuffleboard table and uncover an early hot rod made from the fuel tank of a WWII fighter plane!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Strat'ed for Cash
programme.desc: On a limited budget in the historic L.A. neighborhood of West Adams, Allen and Ton still win three lockers and find a Maui Blue Fender Stratocaster and a 1930s Schwinn bike.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Miami Heat
programme.desc: All-terrain Air Commander Hovercraft, a 1970s NASA countdown clock and a one-of-a-kind 1960s Delta Relay rocket.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby
programme.desc: Ton and Allen have to get aggressive when they encounter a towering opponent with a mountain of cash. The guys uncover a vintage ice resurfacing machine and an Olympic biathlon rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola
programme.desc: Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capitol City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls

programme.title: Scream 5
programme.desc: 25 vuotta sen jälkeen, kun Woodsboron kaupunkia järkytti sarja raakoja murhia, se tapahtuu taas. Menneisyyden salaisuudet paljastuvat, kun tekijä riehuu viidennen kerran. Nyt vain pari eloonjäänyttä voi pysäyttää murhaajan Ghostface-maskin takana.

programme.title: Tommy

programme.title: Hata Göteborg
programme.desc: Draamakomedia miehisyydestä kaikkein heikoimmillaan. "Hata Göteborg" on tarina jengistä, jossa ystävyys on muuttunut terroriksi ja tappeluista tullut jalkapalloa tärkeämpiä. Göteborgilainen Isak näyttää jengille, että elämässä on muutakin.

programme.title: Star File
programme.desc: Steve Carell. Viihdeohjelma, jonka jokaisessa osassa piirretään muotokuva jostakin Hollywood-tähdestä, alkutaipaleelta uran huipuille ja suvantoihin. 2020

programme.title: Kaisa Kullanmuru
programme.desc: Kaisa auttaa mummoaan myymään polkkakaramelleja torilla. Eräänä päivänä mummon jalka kipeytyy, ja Kaisan on hoidettava karamellimyynti aivan itse. Mitenköhän hän selviää tehtävästä?

programme.title: Kalle mestarietsivä
programme.desc: Lillköpingin kesäidyllissä on rauhallista. Moni kakku päältä kaunis: käynnissä on sota Punaisen ja Valkoisen Ruusun välillä. Taistelun kohteena on Stormumriken, mikä ulkopuolisten silmin näyttää aivan tavalliselta kiveltä. Yhtäkkiä ukko Gren löydetään kuolleena. Nyt tarvitaan Kalle mestarietsivää!

programme.title: Ryöstetty Rasmus ja Kalle Mestarietsivä
programme.desc: Lillköpingissä Punaisen ja Valkoisen Ruusun välinen taistelu jatkuu. Eräänä yönä, kun Valkoinen Ruusu on valtaamassa takaisin himoittua Stormumrikenia hän todistaa, kuinka tuntemattomat miehet kidnappaavat Professorin ja tämän pienen pojan Rasmuksen. Eva pääsee kidnappaajien autoon, ja hänen onnistuu eri johtolankojen avulla johdattaa Kalle ja Anders ryöstäjien luokse. Näyttää siltä, että Professori on keksinyt läpäisemättömän peltilevyn, eikä kidnappaajapomo kaihda mitään keinoja päästäkseen sen kemiallisten kaavojen ääreen. Tilanne on taatusti mutkikas, mutta onneksi Kalle mestarietsivä on paikalla!

programme.title: Fake Patient
programme.desc: Om fruktan för döden. Sarja alkaa. Albin on sosiaalinen tyyppi, joka haluaa näyttelijäksi ja tekee töitä valepotilaana. Pian huomataan, että hän on ihan oikeasti sairas. Albin asuu Uumajassa ja tekee lisätöitä valepotilaana sairaalassa odottaessaan näyttelijänuran käynnistymistä, kun hän saa tietää olevansa oikeasti sairas. Samaan aikaan Albin on aloittanut syrjähypyn agenttinsa Cissin kanssa. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Irralliset
programme.desc: Sarja alkaa. Jos pomo antaisi Mathildalle vakituisen työn, säännöllinen aikuisen elämä olisi kasassa. Pää on silti täynnä lapsellista ja kiellettyä... Tähdillä roolitettu samannimisen 90-luvun elokuvan spin-off. Tässä modernissa draamakomediassa seuraamme 30-vuotiasta Mathildaa, joka panikoi vakaan ja värittömän aikuiselämän lähestyessä, kun hänen poikaystävänsä yllättäen kosii. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Opiskelijakämppä
programme.desc: Jenny ilmoittautuu dinosauruskurssille pitääkseen opintotukensa, mutta ystävillä on ehdotus psykologiohjelmaan pääsystä. Saga vie Jennyn pubi-iltaan. 20-vuotias Jenny jättää Eskilstunan lukeakseen psykologiksi Uppsalassa. Opiskelijakämpässä hän tapaa karismaattiset klubittajat Sagan ja Oliverin, jotka jo ensimmäisenä iltana houkuttelevat Jennyn tekemään päätöksen, jolla on tuhoisat seuraukset... Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Pidätä henkeä!
programme.desc: Alas ohjaajat!. Nälkäpelin jälkimainingeissa yksi nuorista näyttää leirillä kuvaamansa videon. Näytös on paljastava, etenkin ohjaajien ja Lon ja Liamin suhteen osalta. Ruotsalaisessa nuorisosarjassa seuraamme kolmea teiniä, jotka tulevat aivan eri maailmoista ja tapaavat tapahtumarikkaalla kesäleirillä. Ruotsi 2019

programme.title: Käsi sydämellä
programme.desc: Sarja alkaa. Pariterapeutti Ava auttaa muita suhdeongelmissa. Omalta osaltaan hän on menettänyt uskon rakkauteen, kunnes näkee mullistavan näyn. Tukholmalaisella pariterapeutilla Avalla on yliluonnollinen kyky. Laittamalla käden ihmisen sydämelle hän näkee avainhetkiä tämän tulevasta rakkauselämästä. Itse hän on menettänyt uskon rakkauteen, kunnes eräänä päivänä näkee yllättävän näyn. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Lajka
programme.desc: Sarja alkaa. Somevaikuttaja Rut esittelee parhaalle ystävälleen ja uudelle apulaiselleen Cajsalle hektisen arkensa mediatoimiston profiilina. Felicia Danielssonin ja Vera Herngrenin satiirisarja. Saamme seurata ystävysten Rutin ja Cajsan päivittäisiä haasteita influencer-maailmassa. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Tervetuloa Sjölyckaniin!
programme.desc: Sjölyckan saa uudet naapurit, joiden kanssa Thomas ja Bernt riitaantuvat heti. Klara on ensin ystävällinen mutta tajuaa pian, että jotain on tehtävä. Ruotsalainen komediasarja, johon on helppo samastua. Millaisia ongelmia voi syntyä, kun kolme sukupolvea kokoontuu kesäpaikkaan saaristoon? Ruotsi 2015

programme.title: Tabitan Tatska
programme.desc: Ilon kautta. Tabita tajuaa, että hänen on noudatettava tiettyjä sääntöjä saadakseen edelleen rahallista tukea. Charlotta tarvitsee apua, ja Majbrittin on palattava Solbackeniin. Gulletussan huomaa, että myös Mattias kaipaa apua tullakseen terveeksi. Ruotsi 2024

programme.title: Padelunelmia

Ruotsalainen komediasarja Fabianista ja Hassesta, jotka päättävät muuttaa sulkkishallinsa padelhalliksi. programme.title: Padelunelmia
programme.desc: Sarja alkaa. Fabian ja Hasse pyörittävät elämäänsä kyllästyneinä sulkkishallia unisessa pikkukaupungissa. Uusi idea voi muuttaa kaiken - padel! Ruotsalainen komediasarja Fabianista ja Hassesta, jotka päättävät muuttaa sulkkishallinsa padelhalliksi. Vaikkei heillä ole hajuakaan koko hommasta, he satsaavat projektiin lapsen innolla ja täynnä tulevaisuudenuskoa. Ruotsi 2023

Ruotsalainen komediasarja Morranista ja tämän aikuisesta pojasta Tobiasista, jotka asuvat yhdessä ränsistyneessä talossa. Albin asuu Uumajassa ja tekee lisätöitä valepotilaana sairaalassa odottaessaan näyttelijänuran käynnistymistä, kun hän saa tietää olevansa oikeasti sairas. Suomen pitkäaikaisin ja palkituin poliisisarja Roba kertoo Roban poliisipiirin arjesta. MTV-alkuperäissarja kertoo tämän päivän poliiseista, jotka yrittävät sovittaa erilaisiksi muuttuneita periaatteitaan yhteen. programme.desc: Jahti. Peder yrittää turhaan estää Bean paljastuksen, ja pankki lakkauttaa trading-osastonsa. Peder tekee Henrikistä syntipukin, mutta tutkinta alkaa silti. Carolina Neurathin todellisuuden innoittamaan romaaniin perustuva jännitysdraama nuoresta toimittajasta, joka ajautuu keskelle valtapelien, rahan ja salaisuuksien maailmaa. Ruotsalainen rikosdraama perustuu Leif G.W. Perssonin suosittuihin kirjoihin ristiriitaisesta ja omahyväisestä murhatutkijasta Evert Bäckströmistä, joka ratkoo rikoksia omintakeisella tyylillään. Ruotsi 2021

Tähdillä roolitettu samannimisen 90-luvun elokuvan spin-off. Tässä modernissa draamakomediassa seuraamme 30-vuotiasta Mathildaa, joka panikoi vakaan ja värittömän aikuiselämän lähestyessä, kun hänen poikaystävänsä yllättäen kosii. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Pidätä henkeä!
programme.desc: Alas ohjaajat!. Nälkäpelin jälkimainingeissa yksi nuorista näyttää leirillä kuvaamansa videon. Näytös on paljastava, etenkin ohjaajien ja Lon ja Liamin suhteen osalta. Ruotsalaisessa nuorisosarjassa seuraamme kolmea teiniä, jotka tulevat aivan eri maailmoista ja tapaavat tapahtumarikkaalla kesäleirillä. Ruotsi 2019

programme.title: Opiskelijakämppä
programme.desc: Jenny ilmoittautuu dinosauruskurssille pitääkseen opintotukensa, mutta ystävillä on ehdotus psykologiohjelmaan pääsystä. Saga vie Jennyn pubi-iltaan. 20-vuotias Jenny jättää Eskilstunan lukeakseen psykologiksi Uppsalassa. Opiskelijakämpässä hän tapaa karismaattiset klubittajat Sagan ja Oliverin, jotka jo ensimmäisenä iltana houkuttelevat Jennyn tekemään päätöksen, jolla on tuhoisat seuraukset... Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Käsi sydämellä
programme.desc: John muuttaa vastaanotolle. Avan on yhä vaikeampi vastustaa tunteitaan, ja hän ryhtyy rajuihin toimiin päästäkseen Johnista eroon. Tukholmalaisella pariterapeutilla Avalla on yliluonnollinen kyky. Laittamalla käden ihmisen sydämelle hän näkee avainhetkiä tämän tulevasta rakkauselämästä. Itse hän on menettänyt uskon rakkauteen, kunnes eräänä päivänä näkee yllättävän näyn. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Karkurit
programme.desc: Ghost. Karkuri on kummituksen tavoin liikkuva palkkamurhaaja, joka on yksikön perässä. Tiimin nuorin jäsen Lori joutuu näytönpaikkaan. Pertti lähtee Ruotsiin selvittämään kadonneen tiimiläisen mysteeriä. Suomi 2021

programme.title: Karkurit
programme.desc: Pidätysmääräystä pakoileva joogaguru on Karkuriyksikön tähtäimessä. Tuore tiimin jäsen Santiago ottaa peitepoliisin taitonsa käyttöön. Lori tunnistaa Karitan luo tunkeutuneen murtovarkaan. Suomi 2021

programme.title: Kunnes kuolema meidät erottaa
programme.desc: Murhasta epäilty. Perheoikeuteen erikoistunut juristi Malin ja hänen aviomiehensä Tobias ovat kutsuneet naapurinsa aperitiiville, mutta lastenvahti Sabina ei koskaan saavu paikalle. Pian käy ilmi, että Sabina on murhattu ja Tobiasta epäillään teosta. Ruotsi 2026

programme.title: Sokaistuneet
programme.desc: 48 tuntia. Finanssitarkastuslaitoksen tutkinta johtaa pankkiluvan menettämiseen, ja Peder näkee vain yhden tavan pelastaa pankki konkurssilta. Se on pakko myydä. Carolina Neurathin todellisuuden innoittamaan romaaniin perustuva jännitysdraama nuoresta toimittajasta, joka ajautuu keskelle valtapelien, rahan ja salaisuuksien maailmaa. Tiivistunnelmaisen sarjan tähtinä Julia Ragnarsson ja Matias Varela. Ruotsi 2018

programme.title: Bäckström
programme.desc: Dolores. Kolme ruotsalaispoliisia. Yksi murhattu, yksi vangittu ja yksi kadonnut. Bäckström turvautuu epätavallisiin keinoihin ohittaakseen Espanjan poliisin. Ruotsalainen rikosdraama perustuu Leif G.W. Perssonin suosittuihin kirjoihin ristiriitaisesta ja omahyväisestä murhatutkijasta Evert Bäckströmistä, joka ratkoo rikoksia omintakeisella tyylillään. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Murha Sandhamnissa
programme.desc: Olivia, osa 1. Kaksi nuorta karkaa retken aikana. Sebbe varastaa veneen, ja hänen ystävänsä Olivian oletetaan olevan mukana. Mutta Olivia onkin pois. Tukholman saaristo ei ole niin rauhallinen kuin luulit. Aaltojen lyödessä kallioita vasten rikostarkastaja syyttäjä Nora Linde taistelee arvaamatonta pahuutta vastaan. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Beck: Inferno
programme.desc: Elokuvassa Beck - Inferno ryhmä saa tutkittavaksi tapauksen, jossa kahden lapsen isä on ammuttu kuoliaaksi huoltoasemalla. Josef on hyllytetty turvallisuuspoliisijupakan jäljiltä mutta saa tarjouksen diilistä Säpon uudelta pomolta Klas Fredéniltä.

programme.title: Aurinkomyrsky
programme.desc: Kiirunalainen saarnaaja löytyy murhattuna. Asianajaja Rebecka palaa vastahakoisesti synnyinseudulleen, kun kuulee lapsuudenystävänsä olevan epäiltynä. Miten Rebeckan oma nuoruus liittyy tapaukseen? Perustuu Åsa Larssonin menestysdekkariin.

programme.title: Uinu, uinu lemmikkini
programme.desc: Creedin perhe muuttaa Bostonista Ludlowin pikkukaupunkiin Mainen rauhalliselle maaseudulle. Mutta metsässä talon takana tapahtuu jotain outoa ja yliluonnollista. Uusi versio Stephen Kingin kauhuklassikosta, joka aiemmin filmatisoitiin vuonna 1989.

programme.title: Star File
programme.desc: Elizabeth Banks. Viihdeohjelma, jonka jokaisessa osassa piirretään muotokuva jostakin Hollywood-tähdestä, alkutaipaleelta uran huipuille ja suvantoihin. 2020

programme.title: Miffo
programme.desc: Tobias on tuore pappi, joka saa työn Tukholman köyhimpiin kuuluvasta lähiöstä. Hän tapaa Carolan, joka on sosiaalituella elävä rullatuolipotilas joka asuu alkoholisoituneen äitinsä kanssa. Tobias rakastuu, mutta kohtaavatko eri maailmat?

programme.desc: Ett avslutat fall betyder inte alltid att sanningen kommit fram. Nya teorier hittas under intervjuer av poliser och familjemedlemmar.

programme.title: Dog Detectives: Unbreakable Bond
programme.desc: Polishundarna Meg och Thor återförenas med sin förare Martin efter att han brutit benet. De spårar en mystisk BMW med kopplingar till narkotikahandel.

programme.title: Blood Runs Cold: A Mother's Love
programme.desc: En mamma försvinner år 1979 och man tror att det rör sig om en flygolycka, men det till synes lättlösta fallet leder till en 22 år lång mordutredning.

programme.title: Blood Runs Cold: One Billboard Outside Tucson
programme.desc: En ung mamma försvinner.

programme.title: Impact Of Murder: Hearts On Fire
programme.desc: Billy Frietag jobbar på familjens frukt- och grönsaksodling och reser under vintern. Hans öppenhet och generositet leder tragiskt nog till hans död.

programme.title: Impact Of Murder: This Is Not A Drill
programme.desc: En vanlig dag på Chardon High School i Ohio förstörs för all framtid när en ung man dyker upp med extremt våld i tankarna.

programme.title: Deadliest Families: Alexa Catches A Killer
programme.desc: I oktober 2022 hittas 36-åriga Angie White död i sitt hem i Wales. Alexa-inspelningar från natten då hon mördades bidrar till att mördaren grips.

programme.title: Deadliest Families: A Mother, A Murder & A Manhunt
programme.desc: En bitter vårdnadsstrid slutar i tragedi när ett litet barn hittas död. En tre år lång jakt följer för att hitta hennes mördare - hennes egen mamma.

programme.title: Deadly Affairs
programme.desc: En kärleksaffär för en begravningsdirektör och hans fru ut på djupt vatten. En inflytelserik universitetslärare förstör lyckan för två studenter.

programme.title: Deadly Affairs
programme.desc: Trots sin fantastiska fru inleder en läkare en affär med en receptionist. En cellist tror hon mött sin like - tills en gammal flört dyker upp.

programme.title: Grave Mysteries: Mother Gone Missing
programme.desc: En kvinna försvinner och skriver på sociala medier att hon tänker ge sig av, men vänner och familj är skeptiska till att hon skulle lämna barnen.

programme.title: Grave Mysteries: Fatal Family Secrets
programme.desc: Det fångar invånarnas uppmärksamhet när den gravida kvinnan Tiffinie Adams kropp hittas på ett fält i en småstad.

programme.title: Last Night In...: I Die to Pieces
programme.desc: 24-åringen Rob Phillips flyttar till Nashville med sin nyblivna fru Kelli för att få fart på musikkarriären, men det hela tar en ödesdiger vändning.

programme.title: Last Night In...
programme.desc: Vi utforskar vad som händer när solen har gått ner och mörkret förvandlar städer till lekplatser där vad som helst kan hända.

programme.title: Deadliest Mums & Dads: The Honour Killing
programme.desc: När försvunna tonåringen Shafilea Ahmeds kvarlevor hittas verkar hennes föräldrar vara förkrossade. Flera år senare upptäcker polisen sanningen.

programme.title: Deadliest Mums & Dads: The Killer Stepdad
programme.desc: Lesley Ford och fyra av hennes barn försvinner från en by i Cornwall.

programme.title: Deadliest Kids: The Murder Of Jason Sweeney
programme.desc: År 2003 lockades 16-årige Jason Sweeney till en lugn plats av sin 15-åriga flickvän, där han dödades av tre tonårspojkar.

programme.title: 911: Did The Killer Call?: Reactions To Murder
programme.desc: Efter att en mamma blivit brutalt mördad i sitt hem blir hennes man och hans bisarra alter ego huvudmisstänkta efter att han ringt 112.

programme.title: Body Cam: I'm Hit
programme.desc: Polisen jagar en konvoj stulna lyxbilar, ett bråk i hemmet leder till att en polis skadas, och en beväpnad man skjuter en polis och tar hans polisbil.

programme.title: Signs Of A Psychopath: Every Time Was Like Christmas
programme.desc: I mer än ett decennium förblir flera brutala sexuella övergrepp olösta, tills framsteg inom DNA-teknik hjälper till att gripa en psykopatisk mördare.

programme.title: Signs Of A Psychopath: He Got Such A Rush From It
programme.desc: Polisen griper ett gift par för ett brutalt mord, men upptäcker ett år senare att det är ett par kallblodiga psykopater som ligger bakom dådet.

programme.title: A Body in the Basement: Her Last Steps
programme.desc: Ett misstänkt inbrott i ett hem i Connecticut gör att en mamma blir dödad och att hennes man blir skadad. Utredarna inser att det ligger mer bakom.

programme.title: Gunpowder Milkshake
programme.desc: Sam on 12-vuotias, kun hänen äitinsä, palkkamurhaaja Scarlet, hylkää hänet. Sam kasvaa aikuiseksi saman rikollisorganisaation suojissa, mille Scarlett teki töitä – ja 15 vuotta myöhemmin myös Sam on kovaksikeitetty palkkamurhaaja. Kun Samin keikka menee pieleen ja pieni tyttö tarvitsee suojelua, Samin ainoa keino on ottaa yhteyttä hänen äitiinsä ja tämän tappavan tarkkoihin kollegoihin.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in Hollywood
programme.desc: Quentin Tarantinon yhdeksäs elokuva. Vuosi on 1969, ja viihdeteollisuus on peruuttamattoman muutoksen kourissa. Tv-tähti Rick Dalton ja hänen uskollinen stuntmiehensä Cliff Booth pyrkivät uuteen nousuun Hollywoodissa, joka tuntuu heille yhä vieraammalta. Matkan varrella he kohtaavat joukon omalaatuisia hahmoja – myös kaupungin laidalla ranchilla asuvan hippiyhteisön.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: The Equalizerin jatko-osassa tapaamme jälleen Robert McCallin (Denzel Washington), entisen merijalkaväen sotilaan ja agentin, joka elää vetäytynyttä elämää Detroitissa. Hän työskentelee nyt kuljettajana ja ottaa satunnaisia freelance-tehtäviä, joissa hänen erityisosaamisensa pääsee oikeuksiinsa. Mutta kun vanha kollega ja ystävä murhataan, McCall lähtee jäljittämään syyllistä ja vaatimaan kostoa.

programme.title: Vaahteramäen Eemeli ja Iida
programme.desc: Kissankulman talossa, Vaahteramäen kylässä Smoolannissa asuu Eemeli ja hänen pikkusiskonsa Iida yhdessä isä Anttonin, äiti Alman, renki Aatun ja piika Liinan kanssa. Eemeli on kultainen pikkupoika, joka haluaisi kovasti olla avuksi, mutta hänen avuliaisuutensa helposti mielletään metkuiluksi.

programme.title: Swing Vote
programme.desc: Draamakomedia tyhjäntoimittajasta, joka joutuu kansakunnan valokeilaan, kun presidentinvaalien lopputulos riippuu hänen äänestään.

programme.title: What's love got to do with it?
programme.desc: Miten nykymaailmassa oikein löytää rakkauden? Tässä romanttisessa komediassa tapaamme Lontoossa lapsuudenystävät Zoen ja Kazin, joiden tapa lähestyä ihmissuhteita on erilainen.

programme.title: Golffari
programme.desc: Huonosti harkittu vedonlyönti pakottaa Stig Helmer Olssonin lähtemään Skotlantiin ja pelaamaan suureen suosioon noussutta golfia. Hänen golfopettajansa on Roderick McDougall, hullu mies jolla on hyvin kaunis tytär. Stigin rinnalla nähdään tietenkin norjalainen Ole, joka aina on valmis antamaan hyviä neuvoja. Pystyykö Stig Helmer swingiin, joka saa pörssihai Bruno Anderhagen häpeämään?

programme.title: Jonain päivänä kaikki tämä on sinun
programme.desc: Menestynyt sarjakuvapiirtäjä Lisa kokoontuu sisaruksineen vanhempiensa maatilalle ensimmäisen kerran yli kymmeneen vuoteen. Vanhemmat haluavat, että vain yksi sisaruksista perii suvun metsän. Mutta onko kukaan heistä halukas muuttamaan takaisin kotiin? Andreas Öhmanin (Avaruudessa ei ole tunteita) ohjaaman draamakomedian tähtinä ovat Karin Franz Körlof, Peter Haber, Suzanne Reuter ja Liv Mjönes.

programme.title: Triangle of Sadness
programme.desc: Triangle of Sadness -elokuvassa mallipariskunta Carl ja Yaya lähtevät luksusristeilylle yhdessä miljonäärien, ystävällismielisten asekauppiaiden ja marxilaisen merikapteenin kanssa. Matkalla tapahtuva katastrofi saa ihmisten väliset hierarkiat äkkiä kääntymään päälaelleen jokaisen kamppaillessa omasta selviytymisestään. Ruben Östlundin (Turisti, The Square) kohuttu ja tarkkanäköinen draamakomedia.

programme.title: Ikuistetut hetket
programme.desc: Palkittu ruotsalainen draama (Maria Larssons eviga ögonblick) 1900-luvun alun työläisnaisesta.

programme.title: Göta Kanal 2
programme.desc: 25 vuotta sitten kaksi laivaa purjehti kilpaa Götan kanavan läpi. Tapaus nousi kuuluisuuteen sekä elokuvissa että videoilla. Nyt on uuden kilpailun aika, ja tällä kertaa laivoja seuraa tuotantoyhtiö, joka on tehnyt kilpailusta livenä lähetetyn saippuadokumentin. Vonna Jigert (Lena Endre), Tricks Televisionin häikäilemätön pomo, on pulassa ellei hänen uusimmasta ohjelmaideastaan tule niin suurta yleisösuosikkia kuin hän kaavaili. Anderssonin veneveistämö puolestaan on tuhon partaalla, ja konkurssi kolkuttaa jo ovella. Miljoonat ovat pelissä. On aika käynnistää moottorit ja aloittaa kamppailu kanavalla!

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Popkulttuurin ikonen kasariklassikko täynnä tanssin ja musiikin hurmaa. Pienen budjetin elokuvasta kasvoi valtavat taloudellinen menestys ja ilmiö, joka elää yhä. Päärooleissa Patrick Swayze ja Jennifer Grey. Nobody puts Baby in a corner!

programme.title: Myrskyn ratsastajat
programme.desc: Moderni toimintaklassikko, jossa Keanu Reevesin esittämä FBI-agentti soluttautuu surffarijengiin, jota epäillään pankkiryöstäjiksi.

programme.title: Feed
programme.desc: Kauhuelokuva nuorista, jotka kutsutaan luksusleirintäalueelle erämaahan, missä vaanii jokin paha. Guldbaggenin yleisöpalkinnon voittaja.

programme.title: True Fear
programme.desc: Ystävykset Nour ja Linn pyörittävät suosittua kanavaa "Äkta skräck", jolla he tutkivat kammottavia yliluonnollisia tapahtumia. Eräs seuraaja vinkkaa Ångermanlandissa 1600-luvulla tapahtuneista noitien polttamisista, joissa kuoli 71 ihmistä. Tytöt päättävät lähteä kameroineen selvittämään asiaa, mutta saavat vielä katua päätöstään. Ruotsalaisen kauhuelokuvan tähtinä Ava Nikodell ja Rebecka Enholm.

programme.title: Pikku naisia
programme.desc: Marchin sisarukset Meg, Jo, Beth ja Amy varttuvat äitinsä kanssa 1800‑luvun Uudessa‑Englannissa isän ollessa sisällissodassa. Neljä omapäistä nuorta naista etsii paikkaansa ja elää omilla ehdoillaan. Elämään astuvat Laurie ja John Brooke. Greta Gerwigin ylistetty Alcott-filmatisointi.

programme.title: UFO Sweden
programme.desc: UFO Sweden on yliluonnollisia ilmiöitä tutkiva järjestö. Eräänä päivänä apua tulee pyytämään kapinallinen teini Denise, joka epäilee, että ufot ovat kidnapanneet hänen isänsä. Edessä on vaarallinen seikkailu, joka vie kauas lain rajojen tuolle puolen ja selittämättömien ilmiöiden maailmaan. Scifi-seikkailun tuotantotiimi Crazy Picturesin käsialaa on myös menestyselokuva Den blomstertid nu kommer.

programme.title: The Last Letter from Your Lover
programme.desc: Romanttinen draama Jojo Moyesin bestsellerin pohjalta kahdesta eri aikakausien naisesta, jotka jäävät arvoituksellisten rakkauskirjeiden pauloihin.

programme.title: Viimeinen startti
programme.desc: Toimintakomedia street racing -legenda Dennisistä, joka yhdessä ex-vaimonsa Toven kanssa yrittää estää teini-ikäistä tytärtään Hannaa osallistumasta autokisaan. Alkaa henkeäsalpaava viimeinen kilpa-ajo läpi Ruotsin.

programme.desc: Helena Bergströmin draamakomedia homoparista, joka kutsuu perheensä joulunviettoon - ja pudottaa pommin.

programme.desc: Kolmas osa äärettömän suositussa ruotsalaisessa komediasarjassa venejupakoista ja huijauksista Göta-kanavalla ja sen rannoilla.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire – Elämä on peliä
programme.desc: Tom Cruise esittää urheiluagenttia, joka menettää työnsä ja joutuu pitämään urastaan kiinni yhden, hankalan asiakkaan ja yhden lojaalin kollegan avulla. Cuba Gooding Jr. voitti roolistaan parhaan miessivuosan Oscar-palkinnon.

programme.title: Non-Stop

Yhden tutkimusretken aikana hän katoaa jäljettömiin ja muut ryhmän jäsenet löydetään kuolleina. Rileyn sisar Mia kieltäytyy luopumasta etsinnöistä ja suuntaa 12 vuotta myöhemmin hylättyyn Shelby Oaksiin. Kaupunkiin kätkeytyy karmiva salaisuus, jonka olisi pitänyt pysyä haudattuna.

programme.title: Kolmas aalto
programme.desc: Lopetettuaan poliisintyönsä Johan Falk aloittaa uudessa työryhmässä Europolissa, jonka tarkoitus on taistella suuria talousrikollisia vastaan. Näyttää siltä, että alkamassa on pitkä rivi painajaismaisia tapahtumia, väkivaltaa ja petosta.

programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Jareds Ford Ranger. Jared rullar iväg tre tum lägre med pärlemorlack i orange.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Pontiac Trans Am
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar West Coast Customs Danelles Pontiac Trans Am. Hon rullar iväg i en bil utrustad med kaffebryggare och kristallkrona.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1989 Ford Mustang

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Maxima Station Wagon

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Volkswagen Baja
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Krissys Volkswagen Baja Bug. Bubblan från 1969 konstruerades med hållbarhet som mål. Men med sitt böjda avgasrör och sina trasiga dörrar kan den verkligen beskrivas som allt annat än just det.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1987 Honda CRX

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: '72 Landcruiser

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: 1989 Ford Escort

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Superscopes
programme.desc: The human eye can only see visible light, a small spectrum of electromagnetic waves. Today, we have instruments that let us perceive all wavelengths.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Night Fire
programme.desc: The Northern Lights are more than just beautiful; they tell us about the make up of our planet, our sun, and may even be a signpost for the possibility of life on other planets.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Race, The Hubble, Chasing Comets & Space Debris
programme.sub-title: The Space Race, The Hubble, Chasing Comets & Space Debris
programme.desc: Cold War & The Start of the Space Race - Cold War rivalry and the acceleration of space exploration. Servicing Hubble - Preparations for Hubble's final servicing mission. Chasing a Comet - Launch and the difficult path to rendezvous.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Stars Above
programme.desc: The life cycle of stars reveal to us the past and the future of Earth and ourselves.

programme.title: The Apollo Experience: Apollo 17: Part 1
programme.desc: Between 1960 and 1972, mankind boldly went where no human had been before. Across 11 manned missions, 24 men flew to the moon and 12 walked upon its surface. This film documents Apollo 17 through the eyes of the astronauts who flew.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rays
programme.desc: Cosmic rays can tell us much about the universe. They are not simply another form of light, but carriers of information about powerful and unseen processes at work thousands or even millions of light years away.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Exo Planets
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer more closely and with evermore fidelity at nearby stars, they are discovering countless exo planets. How many Earth-like planets are out there? Could one of them hold life not so different from our own?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: First Light
programme.desc: The Hubble Telescope is nearing its end, the replacements are ready to go, ready to peer further back in time and space than can be imagined.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.sub-title: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it's also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Return to the Moon
programme.desc: The moon is our closest celestial companion. It lights our night sky and gently tugs at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, but her allure remains strong.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.sub-title: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.desc: Project Mercury Begins - The start of NASA & America's first manned space program. Mars Express - The European Space Agency's Mars Satellite. The Soyuz Launch System - The gradual evolution of Russia's Soyuz launcher.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.sub-title: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.sub-title: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.sub-title: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here
programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Good Collaborators?

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: The Island War
programme.desc: The Marines succeed in the "island hopping" strategy against suicidal resistance. The US Navy establishes supremacy, cutting off Japan.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Victory in Europe
programme.desc: In 1945, Germany is crumbly on both fronts. The Western Allies cross the Rhine and take most of Germany, while the Red Army quickly advances into Berlin. After Hitler's suicide, Germany surrenders and is divided among the allied powers.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The AK-47, the world's deadliest firearm, sparked a Cold War race for superior assault rifles like the American M4 and German HK 416. Host Wil Willis explores its history, from Mikhail Kalashnikov's WWII experiences to its assembly and lethal impact.

Pain, revenge and duty are the stuff that bind us in this world and are the main plot line of the movie, but in the afterlife love and faith linger on.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: As Jane starts planning her wedding to Owen, Annie Maslin seeks her help after her husband Alan is killed in an offshore oil rig accident. While Jane is walking Annie through the story of Alan's death, representatives from Ivar Oil Company are also interviewing Kim about taking their case. But because she's the first to produce a signed retainer, Jane is given the go-ahead to represent Annie. Yet, despite Alan's documented concerns about the rig's safety and the accounts of the tragedy portraying him as a hero, Ivar's lawyer blames him for the accident. Meanwhile, as Jane worries when Owen doesn't call after going out of town to see a friend who he says was in a motorcycle accident, Teri gets her friend Liz hired as Kim's new assistant. And after learning that his son Eric is moving to Canada with his mother Elisa, Parker enlists Kim to help him sue for custody. Though engineer Tom Witten tells Jane and Annie that he agreed with Alan's concerns, he changes his story on the witness stand. While Jane struggles to find a witness who hasn't been paid to support the oil company, a sympathetic Ivar executive hints that there could also be problems with another rig, even though blueprints show that both were in compliance with all safety requirements. programme.desc: Kelly's old friend, Tommy Anders, thinks his fiancée, Marie, has deserted him, and he leaves his Army post without permission.
